text: The City Clerk's Office has received notice that Apt’sqi’gnn ᐊᑉᑦ ᔅᑭ ᒃᓐᓐ has resigned from the Two-Spirit, Lesbian, Gay, Bisexual, Transgender and Queer Advisory Committee effective February 4, 2025. We would like to thank Apt’sqi’gnn ᐊᑉᑦ ᔅᑭ ᒃᓐᓐ for their contributions to the Committee.
The Two-Spirit, Lesbian, Gay, Bisexual, Transgender and Queer Advisory Committee received the item for information.
